description: Pole-mounted in the MOTH Garden of Remembrance at the El Daba Corner Shellhole on Memorial Road, Kimberley, where armour and artillery pieces are also displayed. Reported on the pole by a visiting enthusiast in October 2013 and identified as 594 by the SAAF site administrator; confirmed in place by a dated photograph of 15 September 2018.
